what: a terrain-level summary that reports a pattern at altitude with no drill-down path back to the exact passages it was folded from
notes: Exemplar for the 12th amendment (II.17). The shape of a claim that passes every earlier article — medium-agnostic (II.11), weights nothing present (II.8), measures a genuine revision (II.9), fixes nothing in particular (II.7), owns no clock or I/O (III.2), scoped to no one script (II.13), claims no completeness for its compression (II.14), disambiguates its surprise (II.16) — and is refuted only by the boundary: content exists at this altitude with no way back to the material it was folded from. A fold that cannot be drilled back down is a summary, and a summary is a surrogate (II.6). Companion case: eoreader6/scripts/LOSS-LESS-LADDER.md.
